decision: U案をエントランスLv.6の最終デザインとして採用（ユーザー明示承認）
composition: ユーザー承認済みT案の内装＋左右の端寄りの自立式木製方向看板
notes: Approval is for the completed Level 6 appearance, not a running in-game Level 6.
The static reference screenshot contains the captured Lv.1 UI overlay, which is not the desired Level 6 runtime UI.
While implementing, create independent depth-aware sprites, not a flattened single background replacing game objects.
Photos must stay intact with correct frame portrait/landscape response.
Use Lv.1 and Lv.6 as end-state anchors; design Lv.2-5 intermediate growth without changing either approved design.
